Confirmed: 8 provider-neutral methods (capabilities, startRun, getRunStatus, listRuns, getQuestions, submitAnswers, getOutput, abortRun) plus 4 Consus methods — matches design discussion's corrected "eight" claim, not the brief's erroneous "seven."

All checks pass. Findings:

1. **Grill findings H1, H2, U1** — all three have genuine, substantive fixes, not just claimed-fixed:
   - H1 (method count): design-discussion.md line 71 corrects to "eight," verified against actual `src/dispatch.ts` handler map (8 provider-neutral + 4 Consus), and explicitly notes/traces the brief's inherited error rather than silently fixing it.
   - H2 (compile-forcing-function fragility): §3(d) (lines 241-254) explicitly documents the contingency on the object-literal call shape and commits to a concrete mitigation (one-line warning comment at the call site), carried through into §7 step 6 of the verification plan.
   - U1 (asymmetric binary resolution): §3(d) is substantially rewritten, explicitly rejects the earlier symmetric treatment ("I was wrong to wave it through symmetrically"), applies the operator's purpose-test per-binary, and lands concrete differentiated actions (minerva-plan.ts stays as-is; ideate-to-consus.mjs gets an explicit non-standalone header note) — reflected consistently in §4, §6, §7 step 7, and §8.

2. **File inventory**: `grep -rln "Consus\|consus" --include="*.ts" --include="*.mjs" --include="*.md" .` (excluding node_modules/.git) returns 7 non-test, non-doc source files (4 `consus-*.ts` modules, `dispatch.ts`, `kickoff-engine.ts`, `run-manager.ts`, `plan-runner.ts`, `bin/minerva.ts`, `bin/minerva-plan.ts`, `bin/ideate-to-consus.mjs` — 11 total per §8's own count) — all explicitly covered in §3(a)-(d). `src/test-cli.ts` (test infra, not itself a `*.test.ts`) isn't named in §3 but is addressed with explicit disposition in §5. `run-manager.ts`'s `consus-seeds` naming coincidence is explicitly carved out as out-of-scope in §5, matching the task's example. Extra doc hits (`graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md`, `docs/ideation/pan-6965/prd.md`, `docs/ideation/pan-6965/what-changed.md`) are unrelated generated/ideation artifacts referencing a different "Consus console" concept, not this coupling — reasonably out of scope and not misleading.

3. **Constraints/Risks carryover**: all 5 brief Constraints items and all 6 brief Risks items are present in the design discussion (mapped into §4/§5), none silently dropped.

```
REVIEW: researcher
VERDICT: approve
COMMENTS: All three grill findings (H1 method-count, H2 forcing-function fragility, U1 asymmetric binary treatment) have genuine, verifiable fixes in the current draft — checked against live source (dispatch.ts handler map confirms "eight," not "seven") and against the draft's own concrete follow-through in §4/§6/§7/§8, not just assertion. File inventory: grep found 11 non-doc/non-test source files touching Consus; all 11 are explicitly covered in §3(a)-(d); the one near-miss (src/test-cli.ts, test infra not named in §3) has explicit disposition in §5; the consus-seeds naming coincidence is explicitly carved out per the example given. No brief Constraints/Risks were silently dropped — all 5 constraints and 6 risks map into §4/§5 of the design discussion.
```
